source_citation: Marais EM. 1994. Taxonomic studies in Pelargonium section Hoarea (Geraniaceae). PhD thesis, Stellenbosch University.
source_excerpt: As self-compatibility is not uncommon in Pelargonium (P. candicans Spreng, Marais 1981; P. dolomiticum Knuth, Zietsman 1993; P. oblongatum, own observations), this could be the case for P. auritum, P. bubonifolium and P. parvipetalum.
